description: Choropleth map displaying a CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classification of a peat bog, identified as class 412, overlaid on false-colour satellite imagery. The map shows an area in northern Germany, featuring a large, irregularly shaped central area outlined by a yellow polygon, explicitly labelled "CORINE Land Cover: Peat bog (412)". This central area, visually characterised by pinkish-purple and greenish-brown hues, represents the peat bog. Surrounding areas are also delineated by yellow polygons, showing other land cover types, including darker green (likely vegetation) and dark blue (water bodies). The underlying satellite imagery is from Spot 5 (2.5m resolution, 1/2/3 band combination) by CNES 2011©, distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image, illustrating how CLC boundaries conform to visible landscape features. The map demonstrates the spatial extent and classification of a peat bog according to the CORINE Land Cover nomenclature.
